title: Psalm 116
opening_line: I love the LORD, because my voice

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: I love the LORD, because my voice
text.normalized: I love the LORD, because my voice

text.diplomatic: and prayers he did hear.
text.normalized: And prayers he did hear.
text.reading: and prayers he did hear.

text.diplomatic: I, while I live, will call on him,
text.normalized: I, while I live, will call on him,

text.diplomatic: who bowed to me his ear.
text.normalized: Who bowed to me his ear.

text.normalized: The pains of hell took hold on me,

text.reading: I grief and trouble found.

text.normalized: Upon the name of God the LORD

text.normalized: Deliver thou my soul, O LORD,

text.normalized: I do thee humbly pray.
text.reading: I do thee humbly pray.

text.diplomatic: GOD merciful and righteous is,

text.reading: GOD merciful and righteous is,

text.diplomatic: yea, gracious is our LORD.
text.normalized: Yea, gracious is our LORD.
text.reading: yea, gracious is our LORD.

text.diplomatic: GOD saves the meek: I was brought low,
text.normalized: GOD saves the meek: I was brought low,

text.diplomatic: he did me help afford.
text.normalized: He did me help afford.
text.reading: he did me help afford.

text.diplomatic: O thou my soul, do thou return
text.normalized: O thou my soul, do thou return

text.diplomatic: unto thy quiet rest;
text.normalized: Unto thy quiet rest;
text.reading: unto thy quiet rest;

text.diplomatic: my feet from falling, free.
